prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished editorial illustration for HealthMate+, a Philippine school clinic web app. Warm sophisticated flat painted illustration, subtle paper texture, rounded organic forms, expressive simple faces, dark purple #302078 outlines and clothing, lavender, warm cream #fffaf2 and restrained sage green accents. Inclusive Filipino people. Plain warm cream background, generous margin around complete subjects, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no UI elements. Landscape 3:2 composition. Main hero: friendly school nurse seated at a small clinic desk welcoming a guardian and elementary school student with a backpack. Caring conversational interaction, stethoscope resting on desk, simple potted plant and minimal clinic shelving. Large cohesive scene, not collage.
